summary: @ornikar/repo-config-react-legacy-css preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that runs at `npm install` time. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style (hex-name identifiers, string-map wrappers) and downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating string array `n7gIxM` with rotation function `WV8StW`) whose behavior cannot be resolved from source. The package advertises itself as a React/CSS repo config and has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an alien runtime (Bun) is fetched at install time to execute obfuscated code that Node-based tooling would not evaluate.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
